title: A Giant Hand-Held PS2...Kind Of, AetherSX2 On The Samsung Galaxy S7+ Is Awesome
summary: ETA PRIME turns a Galaxy Tab S7+ into a large-screen AetherSX2 station, pairing its Snapdragon 865+ and 12.4-inch AMOLED panel with a telescopic controller and seven named PS2 games.

blocks.text: This eight-minute experiment is less about pocket portability than an unusual physical format. A 12.4-inch tablet sits inside an Ipega 9083-style controller, creating a wide handheld whose screen dwarfs conventional devices. Gran Turismo 4, Kingdom Hearts, Crash, Devil May Cry 3, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 3, Need for Speed Underground and Tekken 5 provide the software tour. Naming the Snapdragon 865+ anchors the result in a known 2021 flagship platform rather than generic “tablet performance.”

The video and emulator both date to AetherSX2’s early period, while purchase links are affiliate-funded. Seven brief game clips cannot show completion, throttling, controller dead zones or the comfort of holding a large tablet for hours. The wide display also does not mean PS2 software should be stretched beyond its intended aspect ratio. Treat the build as a form-factor demonstration: check controller clamping pressure, weight distribution, charging access and current emulator behavior before recreating it, and preserve correct geometry even when unused screen area remains.
